HOWEVER it GUESSES whenever a reply mentions more than one option label, picking the longest even when the reply explicitly excludes it ('archive acme, leave acme holdings alone' -> Acme Holdings). f1722f2 correctly returns null for all three such replies today, so applying it as written would introduce a NEW defect of the run9/D32 'the reply's own words say otherwise' class. Its 12-case probe contains no multi-mention case, which is why its self-validation reads clean. Its 'D105' number also collides with the existing D105 (P3, bookkeeping) in ledger entry #73.
